# Runtime dependencies, pinned to the versions the golden Airflow image
# (github.com/greenriver/airflow) resolves. openpath-airflow installs this package into
# that image, so testing against anything else tests a combination nobody runs -- duckdb
# was pinned at 1.3.2 here while that image ships 1.5.5.
#
# pandas is here because engine.py's .to_df() needs it (and the numpy it brings), even
# though nothing imports it by name -- duckdb reaches for it internally.
boto3==1.43.56
duckdb==1.5.5
jinja2==3.1.6
pandas==2.3.3
pydantic==2.13.4
